	adoption_bonus = "tr_ap_domestication_adopt"
	finish_bonus = "tr_ap_domestication_finish"

	potential = {

		has_grand_archive_dlc = yes

	traditions = {

	}

	ai_weight = {
		base = 0
		modifier = {
			add = 10
			count_used_naval_cap = {
				limit = { is_space_fauna = yes }
				value >= 40
			}
		}
		modifier = {
			add = 10
			num_vivarium_slots = value:get_vivarium_capacity
		}
		modifier = {
			factor = 5
			is_beastmasters_empire = yes
		}
		modifier = {
			factor = @ap_pending_tradition_suppress
			has_ap_pending = yes
		}
	}
}
